# Battery Sensei

> A calm, native macOS menu-bar app that watches your MacBook battery.
> Smart low-battery alerts, charge limit with Travel Mode, cycle and capacity
> tracking, and a plain-English battery history. Runs entirely on your Mac.
> 5-day free trial, no card. $3.99 once, lifetime license.

Battery Sensei (電池先生) is a single-purpose macOS utility for MacBook owners
who want to slow battery wear, avoid surprise shutdowns, and understand how
their battery is aging. Notarized by Apple, native AppKit and SwiftUI,
supports macOS 13 Ventura or later on Apple Silicon and Intel.

Privacy: nothing leaves the device. No telemetry, no account, no cloud.

## Quick facts

- Price: $3.99 USD one-time, lifetime license (local currency at checkout via Lemon Squeezy)
- Free trial: 5 days, no card required, no nag when the trial ends
- Refund: 14-day, no questions
- Free essentials after trial: charge limit, smart alerts, 30-day history
- Premium adds: Meeting Battery Guard, unlimited Saga history, custom warning presets
- Platform: macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon and Intel)
- Distribution: notarized .zip, direct download from battery-sensei.app
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese
- Public releases: https://github.com/schaier-io/battery-sensei-releases
- Source: private repo (binaries are public, source is not)

## Key features

- Three-level low-battery alerts (Zen / Regular / Senpai presets, or custom)
- Charge limit (cap at any percent, default 85%) with one-click Travel Mode
- Live charge, source, watts in/out, and time-left readout in the menu bar
- Cycle count and capacity tracking with plain-English context
- Heat-throttling awareness with explanation of macOS pause behaviour
- Personal battery history (timeline of cycles, rescues, plateaus)
- Meeting Battery Guard (Premium): warns before meetings the battery won't survive
- AlDente alternative for users who want a one-time-purchase, native option
  instead of an annual subscription

## Auto-updates

The app updates itself via Sparkle (EdDSA-signed). Appcast feed lives at
https://battery-sensei.app/appcast.xml; binaries are served from the public
schaier-io/battery-sensei-releases repo (free unmetered GitHub bandwidth).
